items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: He came from the school of George Duvivier and Milt Hinton, people that... There were his cronies.

ctx.x: hidden talents. And he knows every song -- he knows the lyrics and everything. So when you're accompanying a singer, this can be invaluable.

Joe Benjamin, as I said before, was an excellent musician. He came from the school of George Duvivier and Milt Hinton, people that... There were his cronies. Bill Pemberton. And that's pretty good company to be in as a bassist.

So with these two guys, it turns out that I was in another happy situation as an accompanist to Sarah, as well as playing with some good guys as trio members. And we traveled... We went to California.. Again, we wound up with at least two engagements in the Blue Note that year. Of course, the Blue Note had... I think from the last time we'd played there, it had changed locations to a bigger place.
